sloka: सुसन्धेरपि पुत्रौ द्वौ ध्रुवसन्धि: प्रसेनजित् ।यशस्वी ध्रुवसन्धेस्तु भरतो रिपुसूदन: ॥ २.११०.१४॥
transliteration: susandherapi putrau dvau dhruvasandhi: prasenajit ।yaśasvī dhruvasandhestu bharato ripusūdana: ॥ 2.110.14॥

translations.english: Majestic Mandhata was Yuvanasva's son and father of mighty Susandhi. Sudsandhi had two sons Dhruvasandhi and Prasenjit. Renowned Bharata, slayer of enemies, was the son of Dhruvasandhi.
